g.title: crate Reactive runtime and public handle types for Kivact apps.
crate::data Passive runtime state and handle identities.
crate::diag Per-app trace ring and diagnostics collection.
crate::driver Runtime link to the driver and turn scheduling.
crate::error `UiError`, handler results and misuse panics.
crate::error::sealed Sealed supertraits that keep `HandlerResult` implementable only here.
crate::execution Thread-local identity of the executing app.
crate::ext Per-app extension state for subsystems.
crate::frame Copy execution contexts and runtime-owned dependency collectors.
crate::graph Reactive graph with three-color push-pull propagation.
crate::handles Public Copy handles: Signal, Value, Var, Callback, Binding.
crate::handles::number Explain a signal of another type given where an `f64` is bound.
crate::host The host's view of a runtime: creation, turns, mounts and reports.
crate::identity Opaque App, owner and graph node identities.
crate::keyed Keyed rows that keep their owner while their key stays (`mapArray`).
crate::mounts `on_mount` callback scheduling and deferred execution.
crate::object Owner-bound objects and their lifecycle management.
crate::owner Owner tree and hierarchical resource disposal.
crate::owner_handle Copy handles to owners and to the objects stored under them.
crate::props Property value abstraction and render effects.
crate::props::sealed Sealed supertrait that keeps IntoText from being implemented outside the crate.
crate::registry Thread-local app registry and handle lookup.
crate::report Error routing to handlers and diagnostic sinks.
crate::runtime Runtime construction and shared arena queries.
crate::scope Locate the owner and runtime of public setup calls.
crate::selector `Selector`: O(1) "is this key selected" reads (Solid `createSelector`).
crate::setup Free setup functions for reactive state and effects.
crate::trigger Value-free dependencies that computations track and writers notify.
crate::turn Effect scheduling within a turn.
